note: Santa Clara County Parks campground in the redwoods atop the Santa Cruz Mountains off Hecker Pass Hwy (SR 152), overlooking Monterey Bay and the Santa Clara Valley; four campgrounds plus yurts. The 29 RV sites (crushed-rock pads) are for RVs that connect to both water and electric; an RV may also use a family site that fits it. RVs over 11 ft high arrive at their own risk. --Claude
summary: Mount Madonna (Santa Clara County): fees $30.75 (off-peak family site an RV may use) - $53 (peak RV site with W/E); 29 partial-hookup RV sites, showers, dump; RVs to 30 ft x 11 ft; reservable only, on gooutsideandplay.org, 180-day window, 14-night max. Old 'no hookups' corrected. County pages Cloudflare-blocked; read via Wayback.
